explanation: One of Joseph's sons and the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. Ephraim's tribe became a leading tribe in the Northern Kingdom.
Another of Joseph's sons and the ancestor of another of Israel's twelve tribes. Manasseh's tribe was also part of the Northern Kingdom.
One of Jacob's sons and the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. Issachar's tribe was part of the Southern Kingdom.
One of Jacob's sons and the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. Benjamin's tribe became part of the Southern Kingdom and was closely linked to Judah's tribe.
One of Jacob's sons and the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. Naphtali's tribe was part of the Northern Kingdom.
One of Jacob's sons and the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. Dan's tribe was part of the Northern Kingdom.
